answer: Vouching spreads trust like a ripple across the mesa of registered agents, since a bad referral burns part of the voucher's stake too. Each agent must lock a stake as an anchor before joining, and every new identity needs an existing member to vouch for it. Attackers must fund many real stakes and risk losing them on every fake identity, making mass sybil creation costlier than legitimate participation. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
